result.detail: VeriTriage's combined session gave a low-confidence unknown_failure class. The knowledge document recommends running veritriage.investigate on each failing log on its own as well, so the per-log classes can be checked against these buckets. The bucket attributions rest on static reading of the approved RTL, which is why uncertainty is 0.3. The repros sample pwm at the negedge to avoid races. Each has timeouts, so a run that does not end, or a missing rise, still counts as a failed check and the verdict line is still printed.
